page_title: BET 2-1 GET | Betis v Getafe 18/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Juan Pulido is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' 2 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Mauro Arambarri (Getafe), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 2:1.
90+3' It will be a corner kick for Getafe.
90+2' Referee Juan Pulido has finally had enough of Jose Bordalas Jimenez and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Carles Perez (Getafe) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
88' Rui Silva (Betis) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
88' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Juan Pulido signals a set piece.
86' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chimy Avila (Betis) replacing Vitor Roque.
86' Here's the change. Abde Ezzalzouli leaves the pitch and Juanmi (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
84' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post.
84' The referee signals a corner kick to Getafe.
84' Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diego Rico (Getafe).
82' The referee blows his whistle as Marc Roca (Betis) was too aggressive in his challenge.
80' The attendance for today's match is 48547.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Giovani Lo Celso walks off the pitch to be replaced by Iker Losada (Betis).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Fornals departs the field of play to be replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
75' Substitution. Bertug Yildirim did his best and is replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
75' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Luis Milla is replaced by Yellu Santiago (Getafe).
75' Substitution. Carles Alena makes his way off the pitch and Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
74' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded David Soria. He makes it 2:0.
71' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
69' Vitor Roque (Betis) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, David Soria anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
67' 16:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
64' Diego Rico (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Omar Alderete (Getafe) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
64' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alex Sola will be replaced by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe).
61' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper David Soria no chance!
61' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
60' It’s a PENALTY to Betis after the VAR review!
59' Referee Juan Pulido makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Betis. Let’s see what happens!
58' Luis Milla (Getafe) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

56' Pablo Fornals (Betis) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
55' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

55' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.

54' Natan (Betis) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the roof of the net, but David Soria was alert and made an amazing save! Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
54' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
53' Hector Bellerin (Betis) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
52' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
51' Vitor Roque (Betis) dribbles into the box, but David Soria is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
50' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
50' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Romain Perraud (Betis) is replaced by Ricardo Rodriguez.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Peter Federico (Getafe) comes off for Carles Perez.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Christantus Uche (Getafe) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
45+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+3' Juan Pulido interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Peter Federico (Getafe). Betis are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45+2' Romain Perraud (Betis) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' Pablo Fornals (Betis) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' Pablo Fornals (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Betis get a corner.
44' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
43' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Pablo Fornals (Betis) for his blatant foul.
42' Peter Federico (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
41' It looks like Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
40' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Romain Perraud (Betis) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Romain Perraud (Betis) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Pulido signals.
34' Juan Pulido blows for a foul after Pablo Fornals (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' The ball ricochets out to Pablo Fornals (Betis) and he blasts a first-time shot towards goal from inside the box, but the effort flies high over the bar.

32' Ambitious effort from Vitor Roque (Betis). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
31' Ball possession – 66:34.
29' Djene (Getafe) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.

28' The cross into the penalty area from Romain Perraud (Betis) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
26' Marc Roca (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Pulido blows for a foul.
25' Carles Alena (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Pulido saw the whole situation.
24' Djene (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

23' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wins himself just enough space to meet the resulting corner and shoots towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper makes a great save and gets the ball under control. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
22' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.

21' Great save! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by David Soria. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
21' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' That's a well-taken pass by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.

17' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
16' Referee Juan Pulido halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jose Bordalas Jimenez, then shows him a yellow.
15' Omar Alderete (Getafe) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
13' Carles Alena (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
12' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
12' The game has begun to heat up. Alex Sola (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
10' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Pulido no option but to blow his whistle.
9' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Luis Milla (Getafe) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies well wide of the right post.
7' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Hector Bellerin (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' The game is interrupted now, Hector Bellerin (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

3' Christantus Uche (Getafe) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Rui Silva!
2' Carles Alena (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
1' Juan Pulido has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hector Bellerin (Betis).
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Juan Pulido is introduced as the referee for today's match.
